correctness.rationale: For every p,q>=2, an intrinsic-radius-r ball satisfies X_ij>=r sqrt(1-1/pq) and adjacent Monge slacks>=2r, because projected coordinate normals have norm sqrt(1-1/pq) and mixed normals norm 2. The nonnegative Z=(X/r)-alpha dual identity has strictly positive lambda_ab=min(qa,pb)-ab and pi_ij=pq times interval overlap, so equality requires ALL slacks 2 and overlap cells Z=0. The floor-covariance/sawtooth integral yields T=(p²q²-p²-q²+g²)/6; common boundaries k/g leave g-1 parameters in [-1,1]. This proves the stated inradius, complete cube of incenters and count pq+1-g+e of tangent facets (assuming the Erickson-Kretschmann facet theorem). The p=q=n specialization matches known square radius. Independently recomputed 144 ordered p,q pairs and dual identities with exact fractions; finite checks do not prove the universal theorem.
